<entry id="R00622">
<head-word>צְנִינָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (צנן) 
<italic>prickly, withered</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. צְנִינָן</plural-form>. Targ. Y. Gen. XLI, 23 Ar. (ed. נצן, v. נָצָא II).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>

<italic>cold water</italic> (?).</definition>

<entry id="R00624">
<head-word>צְנִיעַ</head-word>
<head-word>צְנִיעָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. = h. צָנוּעַ.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Mic. VI, 8 (Rashi צָנוּעַ). Targ. Cant. IV, 8.—Keth. 62
<sup>b</sup>, v. מַעֲלֵי. Men. 43
<sup>a</sup> אינש צ' הוה וכ' he was a decorous man and would not take off his cloak the entire day; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. צְנִיעִין;</plural-form> f. צְנִיעָן, צְנִיעָתָא. Targ. Y. II Ex. XXXVIII, 8 נשיא צ' דהוון צ' וכ' chaste women that lived in retirement &c. (h. text הצבאות); Y. I צניעותא (corr. acc.).—Sabb. 140
<sup>b</sup> תיהוון צניען וכ' Ms. O. (ed. תהוי צניעתן, corr. acc.) be reserved even in the presence of your husbands.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00625">
<head-word>צְנִיעוּת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>secrecy, retirement</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to 
<pgbrk id="pg1292" />III, 4 (ref. to Is. XLVII, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> פרשי צְנִיעוּתֵךְ וכ' uncover thy secret, that means the (Babylonian) king that is kept behind seven enclosures. Num. R. s. 1 יפה היא הצ' the privacy (in the Tabernacle) is becoming; a. e.— 
<italic>discretion, chastity, decency, piety</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 13
<sup>b</sup> בשכר צ' … ברחל וכ' as a reward for Rachel’s discretion Saul was her descendant. Ib. ומה צ' היתה וכ' and wherein consisted Rachel’s discretion? Erub. 100
<sup>b</sup> אילמלא … צ' מחתול if the Law had not been given to us, we might have learned decency from the cat; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00626">
<head-word>צְנִיעוּתָא</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> [Targ. Y. I Ex. XXXVIII, 8, v. צְנִיעַ.]—Erub. 26
<sup>a</sup> כיון דלצ' עבידא because the partition is made merely for the sake of privacy (not permanent). Ber. 62
<sup>a</sup> צ' ושתיקותא decency (in uncovering one’s self for a human need) and silence. B. Kam. 82
<sup>a</sup> משום צ' as a matter of chastity (v. סִינָר); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00635">
<head-word>צָנַן</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. סָנַן) [
<italic>to sting</italic>; (of taste) 
<italic>to be pungent</italic>; (of color) 
<italic>to be bright, polished</italic>]; (of temperature) 
<italic>to be cold</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. Yithro s. 4 רחק ממנה צ' if he is removed from it, he is cold. Y. Pes. IV, 31
<sup>b</sup> top שלא תִיצַן that she (the ass in heat) may not cool off (before copulation). Gen. R., s. 87 איקונין … וצָ' דמו he saw his father’s image before him, and his blood grew cold; ib. s. 98 וצינן (corr. acc., or וצוּנָּן); a. e.—V. צוֹנָן.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵיצֵן, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נָצַן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to become cold</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Hor. III, 46
<sup>d</sup> יָצֵן he must become cold (suppress his passion); לא ה' if he does not cool off (what shall he do)? Ib. ויהא מֵיצַן and he will cool off. Ib. ראה … מיד ה' he saw his father’s image and at once was cooled off (v. supra).—Gen. R. s. 20 שמא תִיצּוֹן (
<italic>Nif.</italic>), v. next w.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּצַן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be cooled off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. III, 9 ישן יוּצַן if it is an old oven, it must be allowed to cool off (before being used again); Pes. 26
<sup>b</sup>; 27
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>צִנֵּן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to cool off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 53
<sup>a</sup> לצַנְּנָהּ to cause the perspiring animal to cool off, opp. לחממה to keep her warm. B. Bath. 74
<sup>b</sup> סירס … וצי' הנקבה he emasculated the male (Leviathan), and cooled the female. Ex. R. s. 10 ומְצַנְּנִין אותו (not ומצנן) they caused the stove to cool off. Pes. 118
<sup>a</sup> the angel Gabriel said, ארד וַאֲצַנֵּן וכ' let me go down and cool the furnace &c.; a. e.—[Gen. R. s. 98, v. supra.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pu.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>צוּנָּן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be cooled off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 98, v. supra.—Part. מְצוּנָּן; f. מְצוּנֶּנֶת. Ḥull. III, 5 המצ' an animal suffering from frost; Tosef. ib. III (IV), 19.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִצְטַנֵּן, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִצְטַנֵּן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to become cold; to get chills</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 129
<sup>a</sup> הקיז דם ונ' if one has chills after blood-letting. Yoma 77
<sup>a</sup> אלמלא לא נִצְטַנְּנוּ וכ' if the coals had not been cooled off on their transmission from the hand of the Cherub &c. Sot. 11
<sup>b</sup>; Ex. R. s. 1 מִצְטַנְּנוֹת, v. יָרֵךְ; a e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="R00636">
<head-word>צְנַן</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to be cold</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Yeb. IV, 6
<sup>a</sup> bot. עד דלא תִצְנַן before she cools off (her throes of birth die away); (Gen. R. s. 20 שמא תיצון ותמות lest she get cold and die).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַצֵּין</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to make cold</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. IV, 6
<sup>d</sup> [read:] ההן חלא מרתיח רתחא ומַצֵּין צוננה sand heats a warm object buried in it, and makes a cold object colder.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִצְטַן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be cold, have chills</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 129
<sup>a</sup> ואִצְטַנִּיאַת (missing in Mss. M. a. O., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 80, 90) she got chills.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="R00637">
<head-word>צִנְנָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>cold</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Naz. 22
<sup>b</sup> כי מתפיס … בצ' מתפיס (Rashi בצינ') when a man takes hold (of a dish), does he do so when it is in its original condition (as it is cooked), or when it is cooled off?, i.e. when referring to a thing in a vow, is the vowing person presumed to mean the thing when it is yet prohibited (as flesh of a peace-offering before the blood is sprinkled), or when it has become permitted?; [Ned. 11
<sup>b</sup> בהיתירא, a gloss that took the place of our w.; Ar. reads בצְנָפָא, q. v.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00638">
<head-word>צָנַע</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to hide; to retire</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. צָנוּעַ. Taan. 16
<sup>a</sup> (commenting on the custom of bringing the chest containing the Torah scrolls to the open place of the town for fasts and prayers) לומר כלי צ' היה לנו וכ' as if saying, we had a vessel kept in reverential retirement, and it has been exposed on account of our sins.—V. צָנוּעַ.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִצְנִיעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to withdraw</italic> (from use); 
<italic>to reserve, hide</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. X, 1 המַצְנִיעַ לזרע וכ' if a person had laid aside something for seed, or for a sample, or for medicinal purposes, and takes it out into the street &c. Ib. 90
<sup>b</sup> שהִצְנִיעוֹ ושכח וכ' if he had laid it aside, but forgot for what purpose &c. Ib. 91
<sup>a</sup> כל … להַצְנִיעוֹ ואין מַצְנִיעִין וכ' a thing not fit for reservation, or of the kind not usually reserved, but this person considered it fit &c. Num. R. s. 1 מַצְנַעַת עצמה keeps herself in retirement (chastity). Ib. s. 20 הִצְנִיעוּ עצמן contained themselves (remained chaste); a. e.—Part. pass. מוּצְנָע; f. מוּצְנַעַת &c. Ter. VIII, 8 מקום המ' a retired (well-guarded and clean) place; Bekh. 33
<sup>b</sup>, a. e.—Gen. R. s. 94; Cant. R. to I, 12 (ref. to Ex. XXXV, 24) מלמד שהיו מ' וכ' this shows that acacia wood was kept by them in reserve from the days of Jacob; a. e.—Gen. R. s. 1 (ref. to אמון, Prov. VIII, 30) אמון מוצנע 
<italic>amon</italic> (= 
<italic>amun</italic>) means well cared for (by ref. to אֹמֵן, Esth. II, 7).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>צִינֵּעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to restrain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Bets. V, 63
<sup>a</sup> מי הוא זה שבא לצַנְּעֵינוּ וכ' who is he that comes to put us under restrictions in our own house?</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="R00639">
<head-word>צְנַע</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to guard</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 23
<sup>b</sup> זיל … דלִיצְנְעִינְהוּ (Ar. אַצְנְעִינְהוּ 
<italic>Af.</italic>) go and tell the owner of the goats to guard them (from trespassing on my property).—Part. pass. צְנִיעַ; 
<plural-form>pl. צְנִיעִין</plural-form>
<italic>a</italic>) 
<italic>reserved, kept, guarded</italic>. Targ. Y. Deut. X, 5.—B. Bath. 58
<sup>a</sup> אמאי לא צְנִיעַת באיסורא why art thou not more guarded in thy immoral conduct?—
<italic>b</italic>) 
<italic>retired, chaste</italic>, v. צְנִיעַ.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַצְנַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to put aside, deposit, withdraw</italic> (
<italic>from use</italic>).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Num. XVII, 22. Targ. Lev. XVI, 23; a. fr.—B. Mets. 25
<sup>b</sup> אטו אמוריים מַצְנְעֵי וכ' is it only Amorites that hide (their treasures in walls) &c.? B. Bath. 24
<sup>a</sup> דמיגניב מניה ואִיצַּנּוּעֵי בגויה לא מצנעי Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note for Var. Lect.) as to being stolen from there and hidden, they would not hide it in the same grounds from the surface of which they had taken it. Ib. אבל עינבי מַצְנְעֵי (or מִיצְנְעֵי) but grapes they may hide in the same grounds; a. e.—B. Kam. l. c. אַצְנְעִינְהוּ guard them, v. supra.—[Cant. R. to I, 16 מצנעה, v. נְעַץ.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>צַנַּע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to restrain, make a person respect authority</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. 36
<sup>b</sup> זיל צַנְּעֵיה go and make him respect my authority.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause a person to live in retirement</italic> (a mild method of excommunication).</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 25
<sup>a</sup> זיל צַנְּעִינְהוּ go and tell them to withdraw (cmp. הכבד ושב בביתך, M. Kat. 17
<sup>a</sup>).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִצְטַנַּע, אִיצַּנַּע, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיצְּנַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to restrain one’s self</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. XIV, 15 (not אַצְטִינְעָא).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be private, to be hidden</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 60
<sup>a</sup> מצינא לאִצְטַנּוּעֵי מינך I can be private (protect myself) from thy gaze. Ib. 24
<sup>a</sup>, v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="R00640">
<head-word>צִנְעָא</head-word>
<head-word>צִנְעָה</head-word>
<head-word>צִי'</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>secrecy</italic>; בצ' 
<italic>privately, in secret, without ostentation</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 12
<sup>b</sup> ובלבד שיכניסם בצ' וכ' provided he brings them into his house with the least publicity possible. Ib. צ' דהני יממא הוא the least publicity in bringing these (joists) in is, if it is done in day-time. Snh. 75
<sup>a</sup>, opp. בפרהסיא. M. Kat. 24
<sup>a</sup> דברים שבצ' נוהג one must observe (on Sabbaths or festive days) such customs of mourning as refer to domestic privacy; Keth. 4
<sup>a</sup> דברים של צ'. Bets. 16
<sup>a</sup> כל מצות … בצ' וכ' all commands that God gave to Israel, he gave unto them publicly (for all nations), except the Sabbath which he gave them privately, as we read, between me and &c. (Ex. XXXI, 17); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00641">
<head-word>צָנַף</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. צפצץ II) [
<italic>to shine, be bright</italic>; (of voice) 
<italic>to be clear, shrill</italic>,] 
<italic>to neigh</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 18
<sup>b</sup>; Kidd. 24
<sup>b</sup>. [B. h. צָנַף, denom. of צָנִיף.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00642">
<head-word>צְנֵף</head-word>
<head-word>צְנֵיף</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (of the woodcock) 
<italic>to shriek, squeak</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3).—[Targ. Is. XIII, 22 Kimḥi in ed. Ven. I Var., v. נְצַף.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to neigh</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 113
<sup>a</sup> לא … דלא צָנֵיף וכ' live not in a place where no horse neighs, no dog barks &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00643">
<head-word>צְנָפָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.; cmp. ציץ a. derivatives) 
<italic>uppermost branch; border, fringe</italic>.</definition>

<italic>time; to foresee; to have a vision</italic>.</definition>

<sup>d</sup>; Koh. R. to X, 8; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 90
<sup>a</sup>. Sot. 12
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to והמצפצפים Is. VIII, 19) צוֹפִין ואינן … צופין they see (have a vision) and know not what they see. Tosef. Pes. II (III), 12 [belonging to 13] איזהוּ צוֹפֶה הרואה וכ' who is called 
<italic>a tsofeh</italic> (a pilgrim that sees Jerusalem)? He who sees it and never loses it out of sight again. Meg. 14
<sup>a</sup> (expl. הרמתים צופים, I Sam. I, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<italic>a</italic>) 
<italic>seen, foreseen</italic>. Ab. III, 15 הכל צ' והרשות וכ' everything is foreseen (every deed of man is observed by God before whom there is no distance of space or time), but freedom of will is granted. Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 5 שהיה צ' לפני וכ' it was foreseen before the Lord that they would come &c. Ib. 9 שהכל צ' וכ' (omit היה) for every event is foreseen by the Lord; a. fr.—
<italic>b</italic>) 
<italic>bright, perspicuous</italic>. Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 8 צְפוּיִם, v. צָף.</notes></sense></senses>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [nearest,] 
<italic>associate wife, rival</italic> (cmp. רֵעַ).</definition>
<notes> Yeb. I, 2 כשם שבתו פטורה כך צָרָתָהּ פטורה as a man’s daughter (who was the wife of his brother that died without issue) is exempt from marrying the 
<italic>yabam</italic> (her father), so is her associate exempt. Ib. הלכה צָרַת בתו … כשם שצָרַת בתו פטורה כך צרת צרתה פטורה if this his daughter’s associate marries a second brother of his who has another wife besides her, and he dies (without issue): as his daughter’s former associate is exempt, so is the latter’s present associate exempt; a. v. fr.—Snh. 103
<sup>b</sup>; Yoma 9
<sup>b</sup>; Num. R. s. 7 מסכה צ', v. מַסֵּכָה I. Midr. Till. to Ps. CI ועבר בים צ' זה צלמו של מיכה ‘and a rival crossed the sea’ (Zech. X, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>, that means the image of Micah; Num. R. s. 16, end; Mekh. Bo, s. 14.—Yoma 19
<sup>b</sup>, v. 
<xref rid="R00738">צְרֵדָה</xref>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. צָרוֹת</plural-form>. Yeb. I, 1 צרותיהן, חמש … פוטרות נָרוֹתֵיהֶן צ' fifteen women (married severally to the brother of a man with whom marriage is forbidden) cause the exemption from 
<italic>yibbum</italic> (יִבּוּם) of their associates and eventually the associates of their associates. Ib. 4 בית שמאי מתירין הצ' לאחים the school of Shammai allows the rivals of a woman forbidden on account of consanguinity to be married to one of the brothers of the deceased (without issue); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00744">
<head-word>צָרָה</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<pos> f.</pos>

<senses>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>anguish, trouble, distress, persecution</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 9
<sup>b</sup> דיה לצ' בשעתה time enough for the trouble when it comes (‘sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof’). Ib. 63
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Prov. XXIV, 10) כל המרפה … ביום צ' he who neglects the words of the Law, has no strength on the day of trouble. Pes. 117
<sup>a</sup> על כל צ' וצ' וכ' in every trouble that may not come (euphem. for: that comes) upon them. Yeb. 63
<sup>b</sup> (from Ben Sira) אל תצר צָרת מחר וכ' worry not about to-morrow’s trouble, for thou knowest not what the day may beget. Sot. 12
<sup>a</sup> (play on צֶרֶת, I Chr. IV, 7) שנעשית צ' וכ' because she was a trouble (an object of envy) to her companions. Snh. IV, 5 שמא תאמרו מה לנו ולצ' וכ' lest you say, why should we undergo this trouble (of giving testimony)? &c. Gen. R. s. 81 וכיון שראה שצָרָתוֹ צ' and when he saw that his trouble was a real trouble (when he felt greatly embarrassed). Ib. אל תזכירני צָרָתִיִ do not cause me to mention my trouble. Cant. R. to III, 4 (ref. to Is. XXI, 2) כבר נתעלה צָרָתָהּ של עילם … כבר נוצרה צרתה וכ' (not נתעלם) the anguish which Elam has to bring has already been brought up (prepared), … the anguish through Media has already been created; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. צָרוֹת</plural-form>. Ber. 13
<sup>a</sup> צ' אחרונות וכ' the later troubles make us forget the earlier; Y. Sot. IX, 24
<sup>b</sup> top. Y. Meg. I, 70
<sup>d</sup> לא דיינו הצ' … צרתו של המן have we not enough with the persecutions that visit us (on account of which we hold fast-days), that you want to impose upon us (the fast in commemoration of) the persecution by Haman? Snh. 97
<sup>a</sup>; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00808">
<head-word>צָרַר</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="R00241">צוּר II</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to surround, wrap, tie up</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. VIII, 2 צוֹרֵר אדם בשר וכ' one may tie up meat and cheese in one sheet. Ber. 23
<sup>b</sup> צורר אדם תפיליו וכ' a man may tie up his T’fillin with his money &c.; לא יָצוֹר he must not do so. Tosef. Shebi. I, 9 צורר he may bandage (a fig-tree when the bark is peeled off). Cant. R. to I, 7 אני צוֹרְרָהּ לך בכנפיך I (the Lord) will tie this up in thy lap (reverential expression for, 
<italic>my lap</italic>), i.e. I shall remember and visit this act upon thee; a. fr.—Part. pass. צָרוּר; f. צְרוּרָה &c. Gen. R. s. 14 (ref. to ויצר, Zech. XII, 1) מלמד שנפשו של אדם צ' בקרבו וכ' this teaches that the soul of man is tied up within him (love of life is a natural instinct), or else, when trouble comes upon him, he would detach it and cast it away. Sabb. V, 2 יוצאות צְרוּרוֹת may be let out (on the Sabbath) with their udders tied up. R. Hash. 22
<sup>b</sup> מאתים זוז צְרוּרִין וכ' two hundred Zuz are tied up in my cloak; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (neut. verb) [
<italic>to be narrow</italic>,] 
<italic>to cause distress</italic>; Part.</definition>
<notes> צַר; 
<italic>imperf</italic>. יֵצַר (with ל־, or sub. ל־) 
<italic>to be distressed; to worry</italic>. Gen. R. s. 76 (ref. to Gen. XXXII, 8) ויירא … וַיֵּצֶר לו וכ' he was afraid, lest he slay, he was distressed, lest he be slain; Tanḥ. Vayishl. 4. Yeb. 63
<sup>b</sup> אל תֵּצַר צרת וכ', v. צָרָה II; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵיצֵר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be distressed, worry, feel sorry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 3 אע"פ שה' הקדים וכ' although he (Joseph) grieved over it, yet he (Jacob) placed Ephraim before Menasseh. Ib. היה יוסף מֵיצֵר וכ' Joseph grieved over it exceedingly. R. Hash. II, 9 ומצאו … מיצר R. A. found him grieving; ib. 25
<sup>a</sup> מי מיצר ר"ע מיצר וכ' which of them was grieving? was it R. A. or R. Joshua? Ib. הלך … שהוא מיצר R. A. found R. J. in distress. Cant. R. to VIII, 6 יוצאי … מְצִירִין בהם travellers suffer through them (the rains; Yalk. Is. 333 מצערים); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to distress, oppress, persecute</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lam. R. to I, 5 כל מי שבא לְהָצֵר וכ' whoever is designated to persecute Israel, is first made a chief; Gitt. 56
<sup>b</sup> כל המיצר וכ'; Snh. 104
<sup>b</sup>. Mekh. B’shall. s. 5 כל המצָרִים (המְצָרִין) להם וכ' all that are to distress them in the future; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to narrow, close</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Taan. III, 66
<sup>d</sup> (ref. to Job XXXVI, 19) אם סדרתה … מֵיצַר פיך when thou orderest thy prayer, do not narrow thy mouth (be timid in thy demands), but ‘open thy mouth wide, and I shall fill it’ (Ps. LXXXI, 11). Yalk. Job 927 והֵצַרְתִּיו (not והצרתי) and I closed him up.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּצָר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to become distressing, be painful</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ruth R. to I, 7 הוּצָרָה עליהם הדרך וכ' travelling was painful to them, because they walked barefoot.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִצְרַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be tied up, gathered</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 107
<sup>b</sup> נ' הדם אע"פ וכ' if (in consequence of a blow) blood is gathered (and congealed), though no bleeding took place; Ḥull. 46
<sup>b</sup>. Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>c</sup> top; a. e.—Gen. R. s. 46 משנ' דמו when man’s blood is tied up (runs slowly, in advanced age); Yalk. ib. 80.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
